8.1 API Architecture – Overview

The ABpE Portal offers several API layers: A full REST API (Django REST Framework), simple JSON endpoints for common queries, and a component API for modular data queries.

8.2 REST API (Django REST Framework)

For CRUD operations on the main models (consultants, CVs, emails), the Django REST Framework is used. The endpoints are versioned and support filtering, sorting, and pagination.

# API Router in urls.py
router = DefaultRouter()
router.register(r'consultants', ConsultantViewSet, basename='consultant')
router.register(r'cvs', CVViewSet, basename='cv')
router.register(r'emails', EmailViewSet, basename='email')

urlpatterns += [
    path('api/', include(router.urls)),
]

8.3 Simple JSON API Endpoints

For common, simple queries (that do not require a full REST API), there are special JSON endpoints:

EndpointMethodDescription
/api/stats/ GET Statistics data (number of consultants, emails, projects, matches)
/api/system/ GET System status (Django, Celery, PostgreSQL, CPU, RAM)
/api/recent-consultants/ GET The last 5 consultants
/api/recent-emails/ GET The last 5 emails
/api/user-settings/ GET/POST User settings (theme, language, sidebar state)

8.4 Component API

For even more granular data queries, there is the component API under /api/components/. These endpoints are used by JavaScript components to selectively load data.

urlpatterns += [
    path('api/components/stats/', stats.get_stats),
    path('api/components/system/', system.get_system_status),
    path('api/components/recent-consultants/', recent_consultants.get_recent_consultants),
    path('api/components/recent-emails/', recent_emails.get_recent_emails),
    path('api/components/badge/email/', badge_email.get_email_badge),
    path('api/available-languages/', get_available_languages),
    path('api/set-language/', set_language),
]

8.5 CMS Integration (abcona.de)

The ABpE Portal can be integrated into the existing website abcona.de. Multiple integration scenarios are supported for this:

  • IFrame Embed: The portal is embedded in an IFrame (CORS headers, X-Frame-Options)
  • SSO (Single Sign-On): Single login for both systems (session sharing, API token)
  • API Gateway: abcona.de calls portal APIs

8.6 CORS Configuration

For IFrame embedding and API accesses from abcona.de, CORS is configured:

# settings.py
X_FRAME_OPTIONS = 'ALLOWALL'

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
    "https://abcona.de",
    "https://www.abcona.de",
]
CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS = True

MIDDLEWARE = [
    'corsheaders.middleware.CorsMiddleware',
    ...
]

8.7 Session Sharing for SSO

For single sign-on between abcona.de and the portal, the session configuration can be adjusted:

SESSION_ENGINE = 'django.contrib.sessions.backends.db'
SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'abpe_session'
SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN = '.abcona.de'  # For subdomains
SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True
SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY = True
SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE = 'Lax'

8.8 API Documentation (Swagger/ReDoc)

The REST API is fully documented with OpenAPI. The documentation is available at the following URLs:

  • /api/schema/ – OpenAPI Schema (JSON)
  • /api/docs/ – Swagger UI (interactive documentation)
  • /api/redoc/ – ReDoc (alternative view)
